note: City-owned (South Sioux City) campground in a 133-acre park on the Missouri River across from Sioux City IA; the park has the YMCA, a pool, ballfields and riverside trails. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 135 sites (electric to full hookup, pull-throughs), year-round, phone-only booking, 2026 rates $28-37 a day (unchanged), weekly/monthly terms; map confirms rest rooms and dump. Waterfront riverfront -> riverview: every river-side pad sits inside a campground loop road that runs between it and the bank. Pin OK (~185 m S of the centre, at the entrance); phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview: the official campground map and imagery agree that the rows nearest the Missouri (sites 9-21 W, 105-117 E) are on the inside of loop roads that run along the bank; between those pads and the water are the campground road, a ~30-60 m mown strip and riprap (plus the bike trail on the east loop). The river is several hundred metres wide and in plain sight across the open strip, so riverview; no pad is on open ground to the bank.

PIN OK (~185 m): stored 42.48311,-96.40133 sits at the entrance on Dakota Ave; the loops centre near 42.4847,-96.4020. The city's posted GPS 42.483483,-96.404772 is ~300 m SW at the parks shop, not the campground. No move needed under 250 m, but 42.4847,-96.4020 would put the dot on the sites.
SEASONAL: 'Monthly Sites - $750.00 per month (Limited Site Availability)' - a limited monthly share in a 135-site nightly campground; no long-stay concern.
